invalid_when: descriptor is treated as a conserved or globally comparable quantity
cross-session levels are compared without re-normalization
valid_when: descriptor is reported as a relative, within-session score
no claim of energy conservation or closed-form dissipation is attached

invalid_when: in-window fit quality is reported as out-of-sample skill
a single window is generalized to a regime it did not observe
limits.mathematical_object: any estimator fit on a window [t0, t1]
valid_when: estimate carries its observation window and is re-fit out-of-window
out-of-sample evaluation uses a later, disjoint window

invalid_when: couplings are assumed constant across a strategy-crowding shift
the aggregate is back-tested as if participants did not react to it
valid_when: aggregate is used descriptively, with no assumption of fixed couplings
reflexivity (signal changes the system it measures) is acknowledged

invalid_when: smoothness of the book is assumed across a liquidity gap
curvature is computed over a degenerate (empty/one-level) book
limits.mathematical_object: depth-level order-book graph and its edge weights
valid_when: empty / single-level books are handled explicitly and fail closed
edge weights derive from observed depth, not interpolated continuity

invalid_when: a flow result from a calm session is generalized across a shock
shock and calm sessions are pooled without stratification
limits.mathematical_object: smooth geometric flow (e.g. Ricci flow) over the graph
valid_when: flow is restricted to a declared, shock-free observation window
shock sessions are evaluated as a distinct, separately-reported stratum

invalid_when: the order-flow process is treated as a closed, self-contained system
valid_when: exogenous order flow is acknowledged as an unmodeled input
no closed-system conservation is asserted over the flow

invalid_when: graph edges are read as causal links without an identification strategy
intervention conclusions are drawn from a correlation graph
limits.mathematical_object: correlation / coherence graph over assets or nodes
valid_when: edges are labeled as association, not causal influence
any causal language is gated behind an explicit identification test

invalid_when: structural output is presented as a predictive guarantee
a descriptor is promoted past Instrumented without a passed falsifier
limits.mathematical_object: Ricci / Kuramoto / topology output as a feature
valid_when: predictive use is gated behind an out-of-sample null-beating falsifier
descriptor and predictor claims are reported as distinct tiers
